# ਸਾਫ਼ਟਵੇਅਰ ਇੰਜੀਨੀਅਰ ਦੇ ਤਕਨੀਕੀ ਹੁਨਰਾਂ ਦੇ ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਲਈ ਮਾਪਦੰਡ

## ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਦੇ ਪੱਧਰ
- **ਪੱਧਰ ੧ (ਮੁੱਢਲਾ):** ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਸਮਝ ਰੱਖਦਾ ਹੈ, ਪਰ ਕੰਮ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਲਗਾਤਾਰ ਮਾਰਗਦਰਸ਼ਨ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ।
- **ਪੱਧਰ ੨ (ਦਰਮਿਆਨਾ):** ਰੋਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਦੇ ਤਕਨੀਕੀ ਕੰਮ ਸੁਤੰਤਰ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਕਰ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਪਰ ਗੁੰਝਲਦਾਰ ਮਾਮਲਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਹਾਇਤਾ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਪੈਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
- **ਪੱਧਰ ੩ (ਨਿਪੁੰਨ):** ਗੁੰਝਲਦਾਰ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸੁਤੰਤਰ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਹੱਲ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਉੱਚ ਗੁਣਵੱਤਾ ਵਾਲਾ ਕੰਮ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।
- **ਪੱਧਰ ੪ (ਮਾਹਰ):** ਤਕਨੀਕੀ ਦਿਸ਼ਾ ਨਿਰਧਾਰਤ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਡੂੰਘੀ ਸੂਝ ਰੱਖਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਟੀਮ ਦੇ ਪੱਧਰ ਨੂੰ ਉੱਚਾ ਚੁੱਕਦਾ ਹੈ।

## ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਸਾਰਣੀ

| ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਖੇਤਰ | ਪੱਧਰ ੧ (ਮੁੱਢਲਾ) | ਪੱਧਰ ੨ (ਦਰਮਿਆਨਾ) | ਪੱਧਰ ੩ (ਨਿਪੁੰਨ) | ਪੱਧਰ ੪ (ਮਾਹਰ) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **ਕੋਡ ਦੀ ਗੁਣਵੱਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਬਣਤਰ** | ਕੋਡ ਚੱਲਦਾ ਹੈ, ਪਰ ਗੁੰਝਲਦਾਰ, ਦੁਹਰਾਅ ਵਾਲਾ ਅਤੇ ਪੜ੍ਹਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਔਖਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ। | ਸਾਫ਼-ਸੁਥਰਾ ਅਤੇ ਪੜ੍ਹਨਯੋਗ ਕੋਡ ਲਿਖਦਾ ਹੈ; ਨਿਰਧਾਰਤ ਨਿਯਮਾਂ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। | ਸਧਾਰਨ, ਮੁੜ-ਵਰਤੋਂ ਯੋਗ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਂਭ-ਸੰਭਾਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਸਾਨ ਕੋਡ ਲਿਖਦਾ ਹੈ। | ਪੂਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੋਜੈਕਟ ਲਈ ਮਿਆਰ ਤੈਅ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ; ਅਜਿਹਾ ਕੋਡ ਲਿਖਦਾ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਦੂਜਿਆਂ ਲਈ ਮਿਸਾਲ ਬਣਦਾ ਹੈ। |
| **ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਹੱਲ ਅਤੇ ਐਲਗੋਰਿਦਮ** | ਸਧਾਰਨ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਹੱਲ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ; ਸਮੇਂ ਅਤੇ ਮੈਮੋਰੀ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਵੱਲ ਘੱਟ ਧਿਆਨ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ। | ਢੁਕਵੇਂ ਡਾਟਾ ਢਾਂਚੇ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਕੇ ਮੱਧਮ ਗੁੰਝਲਦਾਰ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਹੱਲ ਕਰ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ। | ਗੁੰਝਲਦਾਰ ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਸ਼ਾਲੀ, ਤੇਜ਼ ਅਤੇ ਘੱਟ ਸਰੋਤਾਂ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੱਲ ਲੱਭਦਾ ਹੈ। | ਨਵੇਂ ਅਤੇ ਅਣਕਿਆਸੇ ਤਕਨੀਕੀ ਮਸਲਿਆਂ ਲਈ ਉੱਤਮ ਅਤੇ ਲੰਬੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਦੇ ਹੱਲ ਤਿਆਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। |
| **ਸਿਸਟਮ ਦੀ ਬਣਤਰ ਅਤੇ ਰੂਪ-ਰੇਖਾ** | ਮੌਜੂਦਾ ਢਾਂਚੇ ਨੂੰ ਸਮਝਣ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੁਸ਼ਕਲ ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ; ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਛੋਟੇ ਹਿੱਸਿਆਂ 'ਤੇ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। | ਮੌਜੂਦਾ ਢਾਂਚੇ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਰਹਿ ਕੇ ਨਵੀਆਂ ਵਿਸ਼ੇਸ਼ਤਾਵਾਂ ਜੋੜ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। | ਲੋੜ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਵਧਣ ਦੇ ਸਮਰੱਥ, ਭਰੋਸੇਮੰਦ ਅਤੇ ਮਜ਼ਬੂਤ ਸਿਸਟਮ ਤਿਆਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। | ਪੂਰੇ ਸਿਸਟਮ ਦੀ ਦੂਰਅੰਦੇਸ਼ੀ ਰੂਪ-ਰੇਖਾ ਬਣਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਤਕਨੀਕੀ ਫ਼ੈਸਲਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਫ਼ਾਇਦੇ-ਨੁਕਸਾਨ ਤੋਲਦਾ ਹੈ। |
| **ਪਰਖ ਅਤੇ ਗਲਤੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਖੋਜ** | ਗਲਤੀਆਂ ਲੱਭਣ ਲਈ ਸਹਾਇਤਾ ਚਾਹੀਦੀ ਹੈ; ਜਾਂਚ ਲਈ ਲੋੜੀਂਦਾ ਕੋਡ ਘੱਟ ਲਿਖਦਾ ਹੈ। | ਆਮ ਗਲਤੀਆਂ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਲੱਭ ਕੇ ਠੀਕ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਜਾਂਚਾਂ ਲਿਖਦਾ ਹੈ। | ਸਵੈ-ਚਾਲਿਤ ਜਾਂਚਾਂ ਲਿਖਦਾ ਹੈ, ਅਸਧਾਰਨ ਸਥਿਤੀਆਂ ਸੰਭਾਲਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਗਲਤੀ ਦੀ ਅਸਲ ਜੜ੍ਹ ਲੱਭਦਾ ਹੈ। | ਮਜ਼ਬੂਤ ਜਾਂਚ ਰਣਨੀਤੀ ਬਣਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਚੱਲਦੇ ਸਿਸਟਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਉਣ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਖ਼ਾਮੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਤੁਰੰਤ ਸੁਲਝਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ। |
| **ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਰਜਕੁਸ਼ਲਤਾ** | ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਗਤੀ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜੇ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਖ਼ਤਰਿਆਂ ਤੋਂ ਅਣਜਾਣ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ। | ਆਮ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਨਿਯਮਾਂ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਰਜਕੁਸ਼ਲਤਾ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਪੱਸ਼ਟ ਰੁਕਾਵਟਾਂ ਪਛਾਣਦਾ ਹੈ। | ਸੁਰੱਖਿਅਤ ਕੋਡ ਲਿਖਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਸਿਸਟਮ ਦੀ ਗਤੀ ਤੇ ਸਮਰੱਥਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। | ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਰਜਕੁਸ਼ਲਤਾ ਦੀ ਡੂੰਘੀ ਪਰਖ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਸਿਸਟਮ ਨੂੰ ਵੱਡੇ ਪੱਧਰ ਦੇ ਦਬਾਅ ਲਈ ਤਿਆਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। |
| **ਤਕਨੀਕੀ ਸਾਧਨ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਂਝੇਦਾਰੀ** | ਕੋਡ ਸਾਂਭਣ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਕਾਸ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਧਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। | ਵਿਕਾਸ ਸਾਧਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਹੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਕੋਡ ਸਮੀਖਿਆ ਵਿੱਚ ਭਾਗ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ। | ਸਾਥੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਕੋਡ ਦੀ ਉਸਾਰੂ ਸਮੀਖਿਆ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ ਲਿਖਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਕੰਮ ਦੀ ਰਫ਼ਤਾਰ ਤੇਜ਼ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। | ਟੀਮ ਦੇ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਤਰੀਕੇ ਨੂੰ ਬਿਹਤਰ ਬਣਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਨਵੇਂ ਸਾਥੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਿਖਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਤਕਨੀਕੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਵੰਡਦਾ ਹੈ। |

## ਅੰਕ ਗਣਨਾ ਅਤੇ ਫ਼ੈਸਲਾ ਵਿਧੀ
- **ਕੁੱਲ ਅੰਕ (੨੪ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ):** ਹਰੇਕ ਖੇਤਰ ਵਿੱਚ ੧ ਤੋਂ ੪ ਤੱਕ ਅੰਕ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਜਾਣ।
- **੬ ਤੋਂ ੧੦ ਅੰਕ:** ਮੁੱਢਲਾ ਪੱਧਰ — ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਸਿਖਲਾਈ ਅਤੇ ਨੇੜਲੀ ਨਿਗਰਾਨੀ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਹੈ।
- **੧੧ ਤੋਂ ੧੬ ਅੰਕ:** ਦਰਮਿਆਨਾ ਪੱਧਰ — ਰੋਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਦੇ ਕੰਮਾਂ ਲਈ ਯੋਗ, ਪਰ ਵੱਡੇ ਫ਼ੈਸਲਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਾਰਗਦਰਸ਼ਨ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ।
- **੧੭ ਤੋਂ ੨੦ ਅੰਕ:** ਨਿਪੁੰਨ ਪੱਧਰ — ਭਰੋਸੇਮੰਦ ਇੰਜੀਨੀਅਰ, ਜੋ ਗੁੰਝਲਦਾਰ ਪ੍ਰੋਜੈਕਟਾਂ ਦੀ ਅਗਵਾਈ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।
- **੨੧ ਤੋਂ ੨੪ ਅੰਕ:** ਮਾਹਰ ਪੱਧਰ — ਉੱਚ ਤਕਨੀਕੀ ਯੋਗਤਾ, ਜੋ ਸੰਸਥਾ ਦੇ ਤਕਨੀਕੀ ਮਿਆਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਉੱਚਾ ਚੁੱਕਦਾ ਹੈ।

claire hargreaves
contemporary glass artist, fabricator, and educator
adelaide, south australia
email: claire.hargreaves.glass@example.com
phone: +61 400 555 019
portfolio: www.clairehargreavesglass.com.au

professional summary

adelaide based contemporary glass artist, fabricator, and workshop facilitator with over twelve years of studio experience across hot glass blowing, kiln casting, coldworking, and architectural glass installation. deeply rooted in the south australian craft ecosystem, my practice explores coastal erosion, tidal memory, and mineral translucency found along the fleurieu peninsula and gulf saint vincent. skilled in managing multi artist hotshop teams, maintaining annealing kilns and glory holes, executing bespoke architectural commissions, and mentoring emerging makers. committed to sustainable studio practices, recycled cullet experimentation, and collaborative projects bridging traditional venetian cane techniques with experimental lost wax casting and site specific sculptural installations.

education and specialized training

master of visual arts (glass), university of south australia, adelaide, 2016
thesis focused on thermal shock patterns in recycled soda lime cullet and marine limestone inclusions, examining how local geological debris alters refractive clarity during extended annealing cycles.

associate training program in glass, jamfactory contemporary craft and design, adelaide, 2014
completed intensive two year studio residency specializing in freeblown vessel forms, color overlay, graal engraving, and production team coordination within a working commercial hotshop.

bachelor of visual arts with honours, adelaide central school of art, glenside, 2012
majored in sculpture and material studies with minor coursework in ceramics, foundry bronze casting, and spatial installation.

intensive summer masterclass in lost wax kiln casting, pilchuck glass school, stanwood, washington, 2015
completed four weeks of technical immersion in large scale refractory mold construction, wax spruing systems, and multi zone kiln programming.

studio and professional experience

lead studio artist and director, port river glass collective, port adelaide, south australia, 2020 to present
founded and direct a shared four bench coldworking and kilnforming studio inside a converted historic wool store in port adelaide. oversee daily studio operations, work health and safety compliance, kiln controller programming, wet diamond saw maintenance, and refractory mold making workshops for eight resident practitioners. design and fabricate limited edition sculptural lighting, large scale architectural privacy screens, and tactile tableware series for regional wineries and restaurants across mclaren vale and the adelaide hills. manage client consultations, site measurements, structural engineering coordination, and custom timber crating logistics for interstate and international collectors.

senior glassblowing technician and gaffer, jamfactory glass studio, adelaide, south australia, 2017 to 2020
led production runs for commercial lighting collections and bespoke designer collaborations during high volume hotshop shifts. trained junior associates in gather consistency, marvering geometry, punty transfers, and team timing as both lead gaffer and primary assistant. assisted visiting national and international artists with complex large scale blown vessels, murrini pulls, and experimental graphite and timber mold blowing. maintained furnace crucible health, coordinated batch charging schedules, tested new transparent batch colorants, and supervised public viewing gallery demonstrations during weekend open studio programs.

coldworking and architectural installation specialist, torrens architectural glass, hindmarsh, south australia, 2015 to 2017
executed precision flat lapping, diamond belt bevelling, acid etching, sandcarving, and optical ultraviolet bonding for commercial lobbies, hospitality interiors, and civic memorial sculptures across greater adelaide. fabricated slumped and laminated acoustic glass panels while ensuring strict adherence to australian architectural glazing standards. collaborated closely with local architects, lighting consultants, and metal fabricators to integrate custom cast glass elements into jarrah timber and brushed stainless steel joinery.

studio assistant and mold maker, claire anderton studio, norwood, south australia, 2013 to 2015
prepared refractory plaster and silica investment molds, steamed out large figurative wax positives, and managed multi week firing schedules for deep kiln cast works. documented firing curves, monitored digital pyrometer accuracy, and performed detailed post firing hand polishing using graded silicon carbide grits, cork wheels, and cerium oxide slurry.

designed, engineered, and installed a four meter suspended installation comprising ninety hand blown dichroic and frosted glass forms illuminated by solar powered coastal light emitting diodes.

public commission: vineyard prism, 2022, cellar door atrium, tanunda, barossa valley, south australia
created a monumental three panel slumped and carved amber glass screen referencing geological soil horizons and autumn vine canopies.

teaching, workshops, and community engagement

deliver undergraduate studio critiques, technical demonstrations in kiln casting and coldworking, material compatibility seminars, and workshop safety inductions for first through third year visual art students.

community workshop facilitator, port river glass collective, port adelaide, 2020 to present
lead weekend beginner and intermediate courses in kiln fusing, bottle slumping, glass bead making, sandcarving, and copper foil stained glass techniques for adult learners and community youth groups.

artist in schools program facilitator, carclew and department for education south australia, 2019 to 2023
delivered hands on sculptural glass mosaic and recycled bottle slumping residencies at regional high schools in victor harbor, mount barker, and murray bridge.

technical skills and studio proficiencies

hotshop operations: freehand glassblowing, solid hot sculpting, cane and murrini pulling, italian and swedish color overlay methods, graal blank preparation, blowpipe and punty maintenance, glory hole and electric or gas crucible furnace tending.

kilnforming and casting: lost wax investment mold making, open face sand casting, pate de verre, deep slab fusing, multi stage slumping, custom digital controller ramp programming, polariscope strain inspection, thermal expansion compatibility testing.

coldworking and finishing: flat lapidary grinding, vertical and horizontal diamond belt sanding, merker wheel cutting, lathe and flex shaft diamond engraving, pressure pot sandblasting, acid frost finishing, structural ultraviolet and silicone laminating, museum grade crating.

software and design: rhino three dimensional modelling for architectural fabrication, adobe creative suite, laser cutter template drafting, public art budget scheduling, risk assessment documentation.

While both Adventist and Baptist denominations are Protestant groups that practice believer's baptism by immersion, they differ significantly in their day of worship, end-times theology, views on the afterlife, lifestyle practices, and church governance. The most visible distinction is that Seventh-day Adventists observe the Sabbath from Friday evening to Saturday evening, whereas most Baptist congregations hold their primary worship services on Sunday. In their understanding of the afterlife, Adventists teach that the dead remain unconscious until the resurrection and that the wicked are ultimately annihilated, while most Baptists believe souls enter heaven or hell immediately upon death. Regarding the Second Coming of Christ, Adventists emphasize an investigative judgment beginning in 1844, whereas Baptists hold varied eschatological views without a shared prophetic timeline. Adventists also recognize the writings of co-founder Ellen G. White as a prophetic guide subordinate to Scripture, a doctrine rejected by Baptists, who rely strictly on the Bible alone. *Early Life and Imprisonment*

Raymond III of Tripoli was born around 1140 to Count Raymond II of Tripoli and Hodierna of Jerusalem. Through his mother he was closely related to the royal dynasty of Jerusalem as a nephew of Queen Melisende and cousin to King Baldwin III and King Amalric. Following the assassination of his father in 1152 by the Order of Assassins Raymond inherited the County of Tripoli while still a child. His mother governed as regent until he reached adulthood in 1155. During his early reign Raymond dealt with regional instability and shifting alliances among the Crusader states and neighboring Muslim rulers. In 1164 he participated in a Christian military campaign near Harim where the combined forces suffered a decisive defeat by Nur ad-Din Zangi. Raymond was captured on the battlefield and spent nearly a decade imprisoned in Aleppo. King Amalric administered Tripoli during this long captivity until Raymond gained his freedom around 1173 after paying a massive ransom.

*First Regency and Marriage*

Shortly after returning from captivity Raymond married Eschiva of Bures who was the widowed Lady of Tiberias. This marriage made him Prince of Galilee and gave him vast estates in northern Jerusalem alongside his own county. When King Amalric died in 1174 leaving behind his thirteen-year-old leprous son Baldwin IV the kingdom required a regent. After the murder of Miles of Plancy the barons selected Raymond as bailli of Jerusalem. During his first regency from 1174 until 1176 Raymond worked to stabilize the realm and maintain truces with Saladin who was rapidly consolidating power across Egypt and Syria. He stepped down from the regency when Baldwin IV reached legal maturity in 1176.

*Court Rivalries and Second Regency*

Over the following decade the Kingdom of Jerusalem split into opposing political factions. Raymond led a group of established local nobles who favored cautious diplomacy with Saladin while a rival court faction surrounding Guy of Lusignan and Raynald of Châtillon pushed for aggressive confrontation. Despite intense suspicion between the two sides the dying King Baldwin IV appointed Raymond as regent once again in 1185 to govern on behalf of the young heir Baldwin V. Raymond negotiated a four-year truce with Saladin to protect the kingdom during a severe drought and famine. When the child king died in 1186 Guy of Lusignan and Princess Sibylla seized the crown with the backing of the court faction. Furious at being sidelined Raymond retreated to Tiberias and entered a defensive truce with Saladin that permitted Muslim forces limited passage through Galilee.

*Battle of Hattin and Death*

The truce collapsed in May 1187 when Saladin attacked Christian territory and annihilated a Templar force at Cresson. Recognizing the mortal danger facing the Crusader states Raymond reconciled with King Guy and joined the royal army. When Saladin laid siege to Tiberias where Countess Eschiva remained trapped in the citadel Raymond urged Guy not to march across the waterless summer plains to rescue his own wife. Overruled by his rivals Raymond reluctantly led the vanguard of the Christian army toward the Horns of Hattin in July 1187. Surrounded and exhausted by thirst the Crusader army was crushed by Saladin. Raymond and a small band of knights managed to charge through the Muslim lines and escape to Tyre. Grief-stricken and exhausted he later returned to Tripoli and died of illness in late 1187 after naming his godson Raymond of Antioch as his successor.
